summary.en: The inner loop finishes for each outer value.
summary.bn: প্রতি outer iteration-এ inner loop নতুন করে চালাও এবং grid-এর কাজ n*m হিসেবে গুনো।

notes: Nested loops are ordinary loops used inside a body. C99 permits the header-local counters shown here. C17 adds no special reset rule: the inner initialization runs again because control reaches its declaration again.

examples.title: Visit coordinate pairs
examples.explanationHtml: The first row prints three pairs with row one, then the second row starts column again at one. The newline is outside the inner loop, producing exactly two output lines. Six cells confirm the product two times three.

examples.title: A multiplication grid
examples.explanationHtml: Each cell multiplies its row number by its column number. Width three aligns the small products. The final row contains three, six and nine. The nine body executions fill a three-by-three grid.

examples.title: A growing inner range
examples.explanationHtml: The inner loop runs one, two, three and four times on successive rows. Their total is ten. Treating every row as four visits would overcount; the row-dependent bound is the key difference from a rectangle.

practice.title: A rectangular star grid
practice.statementHtml: Read rows and columns, each 0 to 5. After the prompt Input: , print rows lines containing columns stars; each row ends with newline.
hints: A zero-column row is an empty line.

practice.title: Count rectangle cells
practice.statementHtml: Read n and m, each 0 to 20. After the prompt Input: , count inner-body visits in an n-by-m loop and print the count with newline.
hints: Compare the count with the dimensions product.

practice.title: Square multiplication table
practice.statementHtml: Read n 1 to 5. After the prompt Input: , print an n-by-n multiplication table with every cell formatted %3d and each row followed by newline.
hints: Row times column is the cell value.

practice.title: Count a triangular region
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , count pairs (row,column) with 1 <= column <= row <= n using nested loops, then print count and newline.
hints: The row lengths form a sum from one to n.

quiz.prompt: When does the inner for initialization run?
options: Each time the outer body reaches that loop
Only after the outer loop ends
quiz.explanation: A new row starts the inner progression again.

quiz.prompt: How many cell visits occur for 3 rows and 4 columns?
quiz.explanation: Each of three rows has four visits.

quiz.prompt: Where should a row-ending newline go?
options: After the inner loop inside the outer body
quiz.explanation: It must happen once per completed row.

quiz.prompt: What changes when the inner bound is row?
options: All rows remain the same length
Different rows have different visit counts
quiz.explanation: The total becomes a sum of row lengths.

quiz.prompt: How does doubling both rectangle dimensions affect cell count?
options: It multiplies the count by four
quiz.explanation: The count is the product of both dimensions.

quiz.prompt: Which loop does an inner break leave?
quiz.explanation: A separate outer exit condition is needed to stop both.

quiz.prompt: Why use separate row and column names?
options: To keep each progression and role clear
quiz.explanation: Mixing updates can corrupt the traversal.

quiz.prompt: A two-by-three rectangle increments count per cell. What total appears?
quiz.explanation: Two rows each contribute three visits.

quiz.prompt: Row lengths one, two and three produce how many stars?
A newline follows each inner run. Which two lines appear?
quiz.explanation: The column counter restarts, printing 12 on both rows.

keyPoints.en: The inner loop finishes for each outer value.
keyPoints.bn: প্রতিটি outer value-এর জন্য inner loop শেষ পর্যন্ত চলে।

keyPoints.en: Reset the inner counter for every new row.
keyPoints.bn: নতুন row শুরু হলে inner counter আবার শুরু করো।

keyPoints.en: Cell output and row output belong at different levels.
keyPoints.bn: cell-এর output আর row-এর newline আলাদা স্তরে রাখো।

keyPoints.en: A rectangular traversal visits n*m cells.
keyPoints.bn: আয়তাকার grid-এ n*mটি cell ঘোরা হয়।

keyPoints.en: Dependent inner bounds can give a triangular count.
keyPoints.bn: inner bound row-এর ওপর নির্ভর করলে triangular count হতে পারে।

examQuestions.question: When does the inner for initialization run?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Each time the outer body reaches that loop. A new row starts the inner progression again.

examQuestions.question: How many cell visits occur for 3 rows and 4 columns?
examQuestions.answerHtml: 12. Each of three rows has four visits.

examQuestions.question: Read n 0 to 100. After Input: count pairs (row,column) with 1 <= column <= row <= n using nested loops, then print count and newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int n;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d", &n) != 1 || n < 0 || n > 100) {
        return 1;
    }
    int count = 0;
    for (int row = 1; row <= n; row++) {
        for (int column = 1; column <= row; column++) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", count);
    return 0;
}

The row lengths form a sum from one to n.
